title: fix(css,html): print input ending mid-construct and emptied inline CSS in the form a second pass keeps
body:

**Summary**

<!-- Explain the **motivation** for making this change. What existing problem does the pull request solve? -->
<!-- Try to link to an open issue for more information. -->
<!-- Any other information related to changes. -->

The invariant sweeps now also ask idempotence of every source cut short, which found CSS and HTML output that changed again on a second pass: a string, url, comment or bracket left open at the end of input, an HTML end tag cut off by EOF, and attributes left unsorted past a dropped one. It also retires the three HTML entries the sweep carried as owed: `removeEmptyElements`, `removeEmptyAttributes` and `mergeStyles` judged a `<style>` or `style=""` on its source rather than on what the CSS renderer printed. On the async renderer path a real build takes, `processAsync` prints again with the answers in hand when one overturns such a choice, and a `srcdoc` answered empty is written as the bare name.
